observations: lib/components/fabro-automation/src/store.rs: the create path has the same latent gap the seed fixed for replace — `AutomationStore::create` validates environment presence (require_environment) but not existence, so a direct store caller creating with a nonexistent environment id still hits the raw FK error (code 787). The brief scoped this seed to the replace path only, so create was left untouched; a follow-up seed could mirror the validation there.

Adding an AutomationStoreError variant requires three coordinated touch points (variant, kind() exhaustive match, server From<AutomationStore>ApiError mapping) — recorded as mx-fdcc45; the E0004 from a missed kind() arm surfaces only through clippy.
